title: Affiliate links registry
description: Source of truth for every /go/[slug] redirect. The build step reads this and writes public/_redirects. Adding a key here creates a redirect; removing it deletes the redirect. Updating a destination requires a rebuild (acceptable for v1; v2 moves this to a Cloudflare Worker + KV).

default.description: Fallback URL used when no region match. For v1, this is the only field used.

note.description: Optional human-readable note about this product (program, tag used, etc.).
